name: open-date-agent-contract
summary: How an agent reads, reasons about, and writes back to an Open Date session.

paradigm.name: progressive fit filtering
loop: seed a preference model (dating) or fact sheet (scholarships) from archetypes
rank/bucket all candidates with per-trait explanations
collect verdicts WITH reasons (like/pass/unsure + reason tags), or fact answers (yes/no/unknown)
fold events into the model — the journal is append-only and the model is always replayable from it
re-rank; show the user what changed and why

entities.Candidate: a person (dating) or scholarship (scholarships); traits are facetId:valueId pairs in `attributes`; scholarships add `requirements` rows referencing shared fact ids
entities.Facet: a dimension with labeled values; `filterable` facets render as narrowing chips
entities.Reason: a feedback tag with model semantics: fixed `effects` (delta or veto on a traitKey) and/or `matchingFacets` (delta applied to the candidate's own values on that facet)
entities.FeedbackEvent: {id, ts, domain, candidateId, verdict: like|pass|unsure, reasonIds[], note?} — append-only journal
entities.FactEvent: {id, ts, factId, answer: yes|no|unknown} — scholarship-side journal
entities.PreferenceModel: {weights: {traitKey: number}, vetoes: traitKey[], archetypeIds[]} — derived, never authoritative; replay the journal to rebuild
entities.ScoreResult: {score, excluded, excludedBy[], contributions[{traitKey,label,amount}]} — full explanation of every ranking

sessionState.shape: { dating: {archetypeIds, events: FeedbackEvent[]}, scholarships: {archetypeIds, factEvents: FactEvent[]}, theme }
sessionState.export: the Agent page (/#/agent) renders the full session state as JSON with a copy button; the same JSON round-trips via the import box

agentTasks.prefilter: compute rankCandidates/bucketAll from the fixtures + an exported session state
agentTasks.explain: read ScoreResult.contributions / FitResult.rows — never invent reasons not present in the model
agentTasks.clarify: FitResult.wouldFitIf lists the exact open questions worth asking the user
agentTasks.extendFacets: add new facets/values/reasons in fixtures; traitKey vocabulary is open
agentTasks.summarizeDrift: diff PreferenceModel.weights across two exports to narrate preference drift

provenance: All candidate and scholarship data is synthetic, generated for this MVP. No real persons, applicants, or awards.
